summary_en: FY3/27 period-end dividend raised to ¥30/share from ¥26/share; full-year dividend ¥30/share (from ¥26). Driven by upward revision of EPS to ¥150 from ¥132.44 following tax-burden optimization from B2B reorganization. Payout ratio maintained at ~20% policy target.
title_en: Notification regarding revision of earnings forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Oisix ra daichi Inc. revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027 upward. The period-end dividend per share is raised from ¥26 to ¥30, keeping the interim dividend at ¥0, making the full-year dividend ¥30/share (vs. prior forecast of ¥26/share). The revision reflects an upward adjustment of earnings per share to ¥150 from the prior forecast of ¥132.44 yen. The earnings uplift stems from a structural reduction in the corporate tax burden following the completion of B2B subscription business (cafeteria operations) reorganization in July 2026, which lowered the tax rate to approximately 40% this period. The company maintains its baseline dividend policy of targeting a ~20% payout ratio while securing investment resources for future growth and maintaining financial soundness. The revised EPS of ¥150 is expected to be the highest in company history.
